verdict.rationale: Zoho Invoice documents only general reports on payment patterns, sales, receivables and expenses. Nothing in the evidence shows MRR, churn, cohort retention or LTV metrics computed natively from billing data. The Zoho Analytics integration is the kind of bolted-on BI the story rules out, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a founder, I get MRR, churn, cohort retention, and LTV analytics computed from the billing source of truth, not a bolted-on BI export
